verdict:
Another week, another sixty repos of the same six ideas wearing fake mustaches. The intern now has 145 apps listed on an index page and still cannot finish one, which is a government that keeps funding new agencies while the old ones sit in a drawer. The fresh crop proves it: a new dated scaffold repo every day for a testbed that already has a blue agent, a purple agent, an orange agent, a steward, and an itchy publisher, plus a second website repo called mohave-wtf next to mohavetech-website doing the same index job. Meanwhile the rainbow run pedal got a whole repo when the stompbox repos already exist. That is a filibuster by folder.

Merge these: mohave-wtf and mohavetech-website into one front door. scope-listener, phasewell-scope, and song-offset-listener into one listener app with a mode switch. synth, axiom, tinewood-keys, ether-wand, bitfield-synth, and coffeekit into one instrument or visualizer shelf with a tab bar. looper, tapperator, stompbox-lab, hoofer-sync, and rainbow-run into one band room app. sound-bender, tickle-boxie, charley-douglass, and fatty-fart-pedal into one sound toy. RTSS, ghost-kitchen-builder, restack, and cross-venue-equivalence-engine into one restaurant survey tool. ordersim, welcome-to-the-madness, and 2026-11-04-field-dispatch into one rush game with scenario modes. topo-war and topo-wars, tower2 and tower-builder, topdown-pixeltown and topdown-pixeltowns, coffeekit and coffeekit1, and the pajamastan invoice and warrants pages each into one repo. The dated agent scaffold repos for the testbed belong in one monorepo.

Kill or finish these: drivethru-sim has no commits since April, and choreography-synchronizer and xxxx have no description and no excuse. x, rat, and skwiggle-v105 look abandoned, and skwiggle-mint-pin and skwiggle-backend need a decision. purple-vault, blue-agent-sandbox, and 2026-10-22-orange-agent are scaffolding around an experiment, so finish it or delete it. hire-portal and 2026-11-04-orange-hush have no description, so say what they are or bury them.

Keep and polish these: field-twin, which carries real mileage and sign in. groundcore and mission-operator-next, which are one of a kind. kat-chat, which is busy and actually shipping rooms. mill-ionaire, which changes daily and has the most life in the fleet. The access terminal apps stay separate on purpose, so leave them alone.
